title: Agent knowledge: rules route, docs teach
description: The in-app agent loads ~43 KB (~11k tokens) on every request: 20 rules (24 KB), 20 tool schemas (17.7 KB), a 41-line knowledge index. Cut the floor to ~24 KB without losing behaviour. Each fact gets ONE home, in this order: a code check in a tool result (refusal or hint, costs tokens only when it fires), a routing rule (1-3 sentences, always loaded), an app:* doc read via read_knowledge (the agent's skills, gated where it matters), or a catalogue entry. No incident stories or dated anecdotes anywhere in agent-facing text; right/wrong examples only in docs. Two guard tests keep it that way: a token budget on system prompt + tool schemas, and a ban on date stamps / story lines in rules and docs/agent. Proven by scripts/agent-test.mjs (real model) before and after. Carries Fabio's upscale-first tip into app:masking.
